About us

A cosy, homely centre — built by locals, run with heart.

Altona Early Education Centre opened in July 2017, purpose-built and family-owned by local residents Grace and Tom Azzopardi. Grace is a registered psychologist and kindergarten teacher, and centre director Sarah brings 21 years of early education experience. In 2023 the family grew again with a preschool and the City Farm Kinder program.

Small & personal

Small room sizes and higher educator-to-child ratios than typical centres, so every child feels safe, welcomed and truly known.

Passionate educators

Most educators hold diploma qualifications or above, supported with above-award wages and ongoing professional development — so they stay, and children thrive.

Part of the community

Free weekly incursions, casual booking flexibility, and a handy spot near local schools — with families praising a team that "care about him as a human… as much as we do."

Our rooms

Four bright rooms, one gentle journey.

Each room has its own yard, sandpit and undercover play areas — so the learning (and the fun) continues in every season.

Our kitchen

Adventurous little tastebuds, welcome.

Chef Lauren — with over a decade in early education kitchens — loves broadening tastebuds with foods children might refuse at home: stir-fried oyster mushrooms, fresh bean shoots, chickpeas and more. Selective eater? Extra veggies find their way in, so nutrition never misses a beat.

Dietician-designed

Menus built with local paediatric dietician Melanie Bouras and Nutrition Australia, rotating on a four-week seasonal cycle.

Grown & cooked together

Children grow and make their own kale chips, pumpkin soup, damper and orange muffins — they've even baked cookies for local firefighters.

Family input welcome

Meal design considers family suggestions and dietary needs, with a downloadable seasonal menu for every season.

Our Services · Our philosophy

Every child is unique — and has the right to feel valued.

We believe children need love, kindness, comfort, support, independence, communication and time to reach their full potential. Our open-door policy recognises that families are the most important influence in a child's life, and our programs extend on each family's values, diversity, needs and interests.

Qualified & certified

Every educator holds ACECQA-approved qualifications plus current Working with Children checks, first aid, CPR and anaphylaxis certification — with ongoing professional development.

An inclusive program

Built on the Early Years Learning Framework and National Quality Framework, adjusted daily to the needs of the children in the room — never the other way around.

Our Services · Curriculum

Good curriculum is ever-changing — because children are too.

Our responsive curriculum follows the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF), aiming to exceed all five national learning outcomes. Educators tailor activities to each child and share what happened with you every single day.

IdentityChildren have a strong sense of identity.
CommunityChildren are connected with and contribute to their world.
WellbeingChildren have a strong sense of wellbeing.
LearningChildren are confident and involved learners.
CommunicationChildren are effective communicators.

Our Services · Kindergarten

Beach Kinder, bush adventures & Tommy the Turtle.

Every child joins a funded kindergarten program from age three — whether they're enrolled in kinder or long daycare. Each week our 4-year-olds head out for Beach Kinder, exploring their community and connecting with nature at Altona Beach.

Four teachers, four superpowers

Dianne shares her strong connection to Indigenous culture and the land · Elise leads literacy and the Beach Kinder program · Sue teaches Chinese culture and language · Kaili weaves cooking and art into every week.

Feelings first

The Zones of Regulation program is part of our curriculum, helping every child recognise and regulate their own emotions — a skill for life, not just for school.

Growing green thumbs

A vegetable garden the children tend and cook from, a worm farm for composting, and rainwater collection — sustainability you can taste.

Classroom friends

Say hello to our frogs and Tommy the Turtle — the very turtle on our logo, and the calmest member of the teaching team.

Child Safety

Safety isn't a policy here. It's the whole point.

"Our number one priority is the safety, health and wellbeing of children in our care." We champion a child-safe culture with zero tolerance for harm, implement all 11 Child Safe Standards, and participate in the Reportable Conduct Scheme administered by the Commission for Children and Young People.

Empowered children

Children are taught their rights, listened to, and involved in decisions that affect them.

Screened, trained staff

Rigorous screening, induction and ongoing training on identifying and responding to risks of harm.

Everyone included

Culturally safe practices for Aboriginal children and responsive care across CALD, LGBTQI and disability communities — reviewed continuously.

Questions families ask

Everything you'd want to know before visiting.

What ages does your Altona childcare centre cater for?

We care for children from 6 weeks to 6 years across four rooms — a nursery (6 weeks–18 months), toddlers (18 months–2.5 years), and two kindergarten rooms (2.5–6 years) with funded 3 and 4 year old kinder programs.

Do you offer funded kindergarten in Altona?

Yes — every child joins a funded kindergarten program from age three, whether enrolled in kinder or long daycare. Both programs are led by full-time, degree-qualified kindergarten teachers and integrated into our long daycare day.

What are your hours and where are you located?

We're open Monday to Friday, 7am to 6pm, at 40 Sargood St, Altona VIC 3018 — five minutes from Altona Beach and close to local primary schools and Altona station.

Are meals provided?

Yes. Our chef Lauren prepares all meals on site from a four-week seasonal menu designed with a local paediatric dietician and Nutrition Australia. Dietary requirements and allergies are catered for.

Can I claim the Child Care Subsidy (CCS)?

Yes — we're a CCS-approved provider, and from January 2026 the Government's 3-Day Guarantee gives eligible families at least three days of subsidised care per week. Our team can help you estimate your out-of-pocket costs.

How do I book a tour?

Call us on (03) 9398 5229 or email manager@altonachildcare.com.au and we'll find a time that suits you. You can also join the enrolment waitlist through our contact page.
